title: Stephen Colbert's 'Late Show' ends with a swan song and a giant wormhole
summary: With a dash of sci-fi, Colbert ended his CBS late-night show with a powerful musical sendoff featuring Paul McCartney, Elvis Costello and Jon Batiste.
